<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the same structure.

The question concerns URL parameter ordering and flag behavior, with "flag" appearing in both examples, suggesting a comparison between two URLs with different parameter arrangements.

The final token `?flag` is the start of a second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), which is incomplete — the model must continue with either more query parameters, a value assignment, or a closing description mirroring the first example's structure (`?a=1&b=2&flag`).
"Another example:" introduces a contrasting URL, so the next tokens likely complete a simpler or different parameter sequence, e.g., `=1` or `&other` or a description of the "flag" appearing first.
"flag" as a standalone parameter in the path.</explanation>
